CBSE Class 10 • Mathematics

Class 10 Study Notes

Chapter-wise quick revision notes, key formulas and exam reminders based on the standard CBSE/NCERT Class 10 Mathematics syllabus.

📚 Chapter-wise revision notes

Choose a chapter to open its key ideas and formulas.

1. Real NumbersEuclid's algorithm, HCF and LCM
2. PolynomialsZeroes and coefficient relationships
3. Pair of Linear EquationsGraphical and algebraic methods
4. Quadratic EquationsRoots, formula and discriminant
5. Arithmetic Progressionsnth term and sum of n terms
6. TrianglesSimilarity and Pythagoras theorem
7. Coordinate GeometryDistance, section and area formulas
8. Introduction to TrigonometryRatios and identities
9. Applications of TrigonometryHeights and distances
10. CirclesTangents and their properties
11. Areas Related to CirclesSectors and segments
12. Surface Areas and Volumes3D shapes and combined solids
13. StatisticsMean, median and mode
14. ProbabilityExperimental and theoretical probability
